object.attr: as implemented: a slug is safe as a file name on each operating system and in git. Only ASCII letters change case, so two implementations agree (review Q57); confirm against 0.3.0 for the Kelvin sign and the dotted capital I, which a Unicode lower-casing turns into k and i.
object.description: Mellon shall derive a view's or filter's slug from its name by turning A–Z into a–z, each run of characters other than a–z and 0–9 into one hyphen, and trimming hyphens at either end.
